name: dev.digline/digline-mcp
title: digline
description: Read, measure and explain LLM eval runs of a digline suite. Cannot promote a baseline.

packageArguments.name: --root
packageArguments.description: The repository holding .digline/. One server serves one repository.

packageArguments.name: --names
packageArguments.description: Whether the store's names may leave in clear: clear, or project, under which every answer carries tokens where it carried names. No default.

packageArguments.name: --name-table
packageArguments.description: Under --names project, the name table as module:attribute, holding its mint and lookup.

packageArguments.name: --tenant
packageArguments.description: Verify the suite's tenant. It never overrides what the suite declares.

packageArguments.name: --env
packageArguments.description: Verify the suite's environment. It never overrides what the suite declares.
